Frequently asked
questions

Do I need an account to place an order ?
Yes, you need to create an account by clicking on "login" at the top right of the website. It's important to log in using an email and a password to access your account. You will receive a confirmation email to validate your registration.
When will my pre-order item arrive?
As soon as your item has been released and is ready to be sent, you'll receive an email with the estimated delivery date.
What is HUSKY returns policy?

We offer a refund on any items returned to us within 14 days of the delivery date, excluding any delivery costs.

To start a return, just send an e-mail to hello@husky.space providing your name and order code.

We are unable to process exchanges and all returned items must be unworn, undamaged and unused, with all tags attached. If anything is damaged or missing from your return, you may not receive your refund.
